description: This PHP source file defines a class `ConfiguratorViewFontManager` which extends `SugarView`. It manages the display and interaction logic for a font manager interface in a SuiteCRM module, including listing font files, generating JavaScript configurations, and rendering HTML templates. The file is part of the SuiteCRM application's customization interface for managing fonts used in PDF generation.

classes.name: ConfiguratorViewFontManager
classes.description: A view class responsible for managing the font manager interface within SuiteCRM, including listing fonts, generating JavaScript data for display, and handling user permissions.

methods.name: FontManager
methods.description: Constructor method for the class (though named as a non-standard constructor, possibly an older style).

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the font manager page, including font listing, error display, and the associated template.

methods.name: _getJS
methods.description: Returns JavaScript code used in the font manager view (currently empty).

methods.name: getYuiColumnDefs
methods.description: Generates the column definitions JSON string for the YUI DataTable component based on the font list.

methods.name: getYuiDataSource
methods.description: Prepares the data source JSON array for the YUI DataTable, representing font file information.

methods.name: getYuiResponseSchema
methods.description: Provides the schema definition for the YUI DataTable's expected data fields.

methods.name: formatStyle
methods.description: Returns an HTML string representing the style (bold, italics) of a font based on its style attribute.

methods.name: formatType
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly string label for a font's type.

methods.name: isAllOOBFont
methods.description: Checks whether all fonts in the list are core fonts from the default font path.
